Tier 1 (the internal-only model family name) has no baseline mechanism at all -- it is a hard zero. An increase, or a hit in an unpinned file, is red; a decrease is green and prints a tighten hint. Counts are over TRACKED REAL FILES ONLY: this tree carries 28 tracked symlinks (Aliases/bithuman and 27 under packages/flutter-plugin/{ios,macos}/Classes) that point at the one real copy under shared/Classes, and following them counted that copy three times.
